## Gate interface

A metered read the run stopped at: its price, waiting for approval. Its id is the same for the  same loader keys (the loader, its version, the restriction, the keys and what each reads),  whichever steps asked, so the approval can be passed to the next run.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface Gate 
```
